allytips: Use Thundering Smash to close gaps and stun enemies, then follow up with Frenzied Maul for sustained damage.
Sky Splitter is effective at dealing area-of-effect damage and slowing multiple targets. Position it to hit as many enemies as possible.
Stormbringer can be used to disrupt enemy objectives by disabling towers and gaining health.
enemytips: Avoid standing in the path of Thundering Smash, as it will stun you on impact.
Try to stay out of range of Sky Splitter's lightning bolt to avoid both damage and slow effects.
Interrupt Stormbringer if possible, as it can significantly disrupt your team's objectives.
